evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce MESA, an evaluation framework designed for precise, reproducible measurement of language-conditioned policy generalization.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: MESA provides five evaluation suites that isolate in-distribution performance and four distinct axes of generalization: spatial configuration, object instance, object category, and subtask composition, enabling researchers to diagnose where and why policies fail, not just whether they fail.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: We evaluate seven baseline methods spanning diffusion policies, VLM-based approaches, and pretrained VLAs, finding that the strongest model achieves only 52% on MESA and 49% on BiMESA, providing meaningful signal while leaving ample room for progress.
